# Graph Health Log

## Purpose
Track quality, connectedness, and maintenance over time.

## Candidate fields
- date
- frontmatter coverage
- qmd coverage
- average related-links/page
- orphan count
- pages missing provenance
- pages missing freshness
- pages with no inbound hub

## Inspiration
Directly inspired by the old vault quality baseline and health log pattern.
